language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.

Hello! I am Haja and I would like to welcome you to Madagascar! I live on this majestic pirate ship with my family, who are pirates too! Well, except for my son, he wants to be a scientist. Where is the gold and plunder in that?

Yesterday, I was talking with my son about forces and this is what he said: a force is a push or pull on an object which causes an object to move. This means when there is an interaction between two objects, force is created. You cannot see a force but you can see its effect.
For example, if I push this rock, it moves! The interaction between my hand and the rock creates a type of force. Some forces are created even when objects do not touch. Sounds vague? Let's explore!

There are many different types of forces! We will help you understand some of them better. The forces are; elastic spring force, magnetic force, air resistance, friction and gravity.
Join us!

Hi friends, let's play a game. I'm going to give you some true and false questions and let's see if you can answer them!
To help you, let me explain something about magnetic and elastic forces.
Magnetic force is the force between magnets. It's invisible! Magnets pull certain metals towards them, so they stick together.
Think about a magnet on your fridge. Magnets also attract and pull on each other. They have two poles: north and south.
Different poles attract each other, like metal and magnets. The same poles push each other away!
Elastic spring force occurs when a spring is stretched or compressed. When this occurs, the spring uses energy to return to its original position. Good luck!

It's so windy here. I am finding it difficult to move. Do you know why? It's due to air resistance.
Air resistance is a term used to describe the force that air exerts on an object moving through it. To put it more easily: air resistance causes objects to slow down in air.
Air resistance works in the opposite direction as the direction of motion of an object. For example, when you are running, the air pushing against you makes you slow down.
Objects and animals, such as birds, with a streamlined shape encounter less air resistance since they are able to push through wind more effectively.
The amount of air resistance an object encounters is dependant on its weight, size and shape.

Friction is a force created when two surfaces come in contact with one another. Friction makes it harder for things to move and causes objects to slow down.
There is less friction on a smooth surface and more friction on a rough surface. In a way, this is very related to water and air resistance. The friction slows everything down.
For example, if you were to roll a toy car on a wooden floor, it would move faster. That is because there is less friction as the wooden floor surface is smooth.
However, if you roll the toy car on a rocky surface, it would move slower because the rocky surface creates more friction.

Let's learn about gravity. Gravity is the force which pulls objects to the Earth. In everyday life, gravity is the force which keep us on the ground! Without gravity, we would be floating in the sky. Because of gravity, objects have weight. How much an object weighs depends on its mass and gravitational pull.

Mass refers to the amount of matter that is in an object. Even if your mass stays the same, your weight can change when gravity changes! Just think of astronauts in space. They become weightless in space and can float around.
